entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker pyromancer who defies Jace to protect Loot, is mind-struck, and is healed by Elspeth.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother who joins Team Avishkar and is nearly killed by a guard.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: The goblin engineer who pilots the crashing car and later sends drones to scout.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A small creature Jace mind-controls and then carries off.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage working with the Consulate's guards who mind-controls the racers and takes Loot.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who fights alongside Jace, hesitates, and leaves with him.

entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: The masked racer who injects aether and rescues the Nalaars, then becomes part of Team Avishkar.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: Sita's father who lectures her during his coup attempt and is later jailed.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Chandra's girlfriend, a non-planeswalker who commands vines and finds Chandra wounded.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A radiant archangel who fights the dragon, heals Chandra and warns of dragon outbreaks.

entities.name: Vin
entities.description: A commentator who broadcasts the finish-line fight and is saved by Elspeth.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A racer who tries to reach the finish line on a broken leg and is dragged back to hell.

entities.name: Zahur
entities.description: The Champions' leader who calls the hippos pulling the chariot over the finish line.

entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: The sand-bending champion who shields civilians and crosses the finish line first.

entities.name: Far Fortune
entities.description: An Endriders racer mind-controlled by Jace.

entities.name: Captain Howler
entities.description: A mind-controlled racer who splinters a scaffold.

entities.name: Redshift
entities.description: A goblin whose rockets land near Chandra while controlled.

entities.name: Ral
entities.description: Someone who told Chandra that Jace and Vraska were alive.

entities.name: The Dragon
entities.description: A fire-breathing dragon that attacks Ghirapur during the race's end, part of a primordial storm.

entities.name: Consulate Guards
entities.description: Armed goons loyal to Mohar who hold the finish line.

entities.name: Team Avishkar
entities.description: The informal alliance of Chandra, Pia and Sita after the race.

entities.name: Champions of Amonkhet
entities.description: The Amonkheti team that wins the Grand Prix.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: The prize awarded to the Champions of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city on Avishkar where the finish line is.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane of Kaladesh, renamed.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane of the winning Champions.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where a man in blue stands with a creature in his arms.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Planar routes through which dragons arrive.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The race that ends in a showdown at the finish line.

events.summary: Falling toward Ghirapur, Chandra sees the crowd panicking instead of celebrating.
events.quote: But as she realizes that the masses below are not celebrating but panicking, a different feeling takes hold.

events.summary: Pia identifies the guards below as Consulate thugs.
events.quote: From the colors, those are Consulate thugs

events.summary: Chandra scorches a roof to slow the falling car, then jumps clear.
events.quote: She aims for a sturdy-looking roof instead, then scorches the side of the same building all the way down to try and slow them down.

events.summary: Chandra lands in a cart of racing-team plush toys.
events.quote: She lands in a cart of plush toys themed after each of the racing teams.

events.summary: Chandra sees Jace flanked by the Consulate's goons, with Vraska at his side.
events.quote: Her eyes find him where she least expected him: flanked on either side by the Consulate's powerfully muscled goons.

events.summary: Jace raises a hand and Loot's eyes go blank.
events.quote: Jace raises a hand, and the little guy's eyes go blank.

events.summary: A storm and a screeching dragon roar over Ghirapur.
events.quote: Worse is the horrible, screeching roar of what can only be a dragon.

events.summary: The city's defenses open fire at the dragon.
events.quote: Bolts of aether fire at the massive silhouette soaring above the skies of Ghirapur.

events.summary: The dragon melts a roof cannon.
events.quote: Its blazing breath melts one of the roof-mounted defense cannons to little more than slag.

events.summary: Chandra refuses to hand Loot over to Jace.
events.quote: I told Loot I would look after him,

events.summary: Jace sends armored guards to attack Chandra.
events.quote: A wave of his hands sends the armored toughs charging straight at her.

events.summary: Chandra's fireball passes through an illusion of Jace.
events.quote: An illusion. Of course.

events.summary: Chandra sees that the golden wall trapped racers including the Aether Rangers.
events.quote: The Aether Rangers aren't the only ones who got caught in the trap, either.

events.summary: Jace casts a spell of misty white that turns the wrecked racers' eyes white and makes them attack Chandra.
events.quote: Spirals of magic flash around Jace; a net of misty white surrounds the racers still pulling themselves from the wrecks.

events.summary: Racers charge Chandra as one, including Captain Howler and Redshift.
events.quote: As one, they charge.

events.summary: Vraska orders her group to apprehend Chandra hidden in a wreck.
events.quote: The pyromancer's in there. Apprehend her.

events.summary: Guarded by her father, Sita plans to use her last aether canister to cross the finish line.
events.quote: Most important of all, she still has one canister left.

events.summary: Guards seize Pia and put a blade to her throat as Chandra is dragged away.
events.quote: The guards grab Pia by the hair, put a blade to her throat

events.summary: Sita injects aether instead of racing to the Aetherspark.
events.quote: Canister meets port; aether meets bloodstream.

events.summary: Sita breaks free and disarms the guards to save Pia.
events.quote: Sita throws off the hands keeping her in place, rushes past her hapless father, and dives straight for Pia Nalaar.

events.summary: Chandra, Pia and Sita fight together as Team Avishkar.
events.quote: Engine, wheels, and transmission. Chandra, Pia, and Sita.

events.summary: Daretti sends drones to scout and Loot wakes from Jace's control.
events.quote: Even Loot's woken up

events.summary: Vin broadcasts live from behind a statue as the fight rages.
events.quote: It's your in- vin -cible pal Vin, reporting live from the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

events.summary: Jace unleashes a punishing mind attack on Chandra and the others.
events.quote: Whatever magic Jace is using against her is nasty stuff

events.summary: Jace picks up the little creature from Chandra's crumpled form.
events.quote: He watches as Jace picks up something from Chandra's crumpled form—a little creature of some kind.

events.summary: An archangel shields Vin from the dragon's fire.
events.quote: Hovering before Vin is an angel.

events.summary: Nissa arrives riding vines toward the stadium to reach Chandra.
events.quote: Nissa surfs through the streets toward the Ghirapur Stadium.

events.summary: Nissa sees Elspeth fighting the dragon.
events.quote: Elspeth's got the dragon handled.

events.summary: Nissa finds Chandra, Pia and Sita collapsed.
events.quote: Crumpled before the remnants of a great ship: Chandra, Pia, and that other girl she'd seen on the broadcast.

events.summary: Nissa sees Jace scoop up the limp creature.
events.quote: She turns to see Jace scooping up a limp, small creature.

events.summary: Jace calls Vraska away, leaving with Loot.
events.quote: We're leaving, Vraska,

events.summary: Nissa begs them to stay but a magical fog covers their escape.
events.quote: But by then, a haze of magical fog overtakes the clearing, and Nissa knows it's no use.

events.summary: Winter, with a broken leg, tries to cross the undefended finish line on foot.
events.quote: The rules don't say anything about crossing the finish line on foot.

events.summary: Basri shields civilians with sand that turns to glass in the dragon's heat.
events.quote: Basri Ket conjured waves of sand to shield the fleeing civilians

events.summary: Zahur and Basri realize they have crossed the finish line first, and Zahur declares the Aetherspark's blessing.
events.quote: For life, for death, for Amonkhet.

events.summary: A door appears and Winter is dragged back to hell as the Amonkheti win.
events.quote: But they will make no mention of the man so close to victory dragged with awful finality back to hell.

events.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra's injuries with concentrated light.
events.quote: Concentrated light illuminates Chandra's forehead, her back, her ribs

events.summary: Elspeth warns that a storm of primordial magic is leaving dragons on planes that never knew them.
events.quote: A raging storm of primordial magic has been flowing between worlds, leaving dragons in its wake.

events.summary: Elspeth blesses Chandra and Nissa and vanishes in a flash.
events.quote: And many blessings on your relationship.

events.summary: Sita reveals her father Mohar is in jail for attempting a coup.
events.quote: Considering he's in jail, I think he has worse things to worry about

events.summary: Chandra hugs Sita and introduces Nissa.
events.quote: You really saved me and mom out there!

events.summary: The Champions receive the Aetherspark together as a team.
events.quote: When they receive the Aetherspark, it is as a team—no one person's hand touches it before any other.

events.summary: On a cliff overlooking the steppes of Tarkir, a man in blue and a woman stand while a sleeping, restless creature is held in his arms.
events.quote: A creature is asleep in his arms.

relations.note: Jace opposes her when she shields Loot.
relations.quote: Chandra, let's not make this difficult.
When she spots her mother helping onlookers evacuate

relations.note: Heals her and fights the dragon.

relations.quote: You've never been the boor, Sita.
After a race across three planes, Team Avishkar is finally in alignment.
